description: This file defines a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer for detecting alias clashes in Orleans grain interface and type definitions. It analyzes C# source code to identify duplicate type and method aliases that could cause conflicts within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn analyzer class that detects alias clashes in Orleans source code.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up analysis actions for various syntax node types and compilation end to detect alias clashes.

methods.name: CollectTypeAliases
methods.description: Collects type alias attributes from type declarations to check for duplicate aliases.

methods.name: CheckMethodAliases
methods.description: Checks for duplicate method aliases within interface declarations and suggests unique names.

methods.name: ParsePrefixAndNumericSuffix
methods.description: Parses alias strings to separate prefix and numeric suffix for alias renaming.

methods.name: GetNumericSuffixLength
methods.description: Determines the length of the numeric suffix at the end of an alias string.
